catalysts.headline: Lightwave Logic fell on reports that foundry integration delays pushed expected volume production back to 2028
Lightwave Logic announced the timing of its Q3 2026 financial results and business update call, scheduled for 2026-11-10 at 4:30pm ET
catalysts.impact: Scheduling announcement ahead of the Q3 2026 print

conflicts: Share price: ~$4.65-$4.94 (early Nov 2026) vs a reported $18.22 close on 2026-05-13 (+14.38% that day) — implies a roughly 73% decline over six months. This is large but was not independently corroborated with an intermediate data point in this search, so it is flagged for review rather than assumed to reflect a reverse split or data error.

Cash position timing: a Panabee analysis cites $95.9M total liquid assets as of Q2 2026 (2026-06-30); a separate, older piece describes the company having 'ended the quarter with $75 million... rising to $100 million as of 2026-05-11,' which appears to describe Q1 2026 — these are different quarters and should not be conflated as the same balance.

Q3 2026 actual results could not be located despite the earnings call having been held on 2026-11-10 (three days before this report's date); only a pre-report consensus estimate (-$0.05 EPS) was found.
notes: LWLG is a pre-revenue/development-stage photonics/polymer-materials company; losses are expected to continue until commercial production ramps, which management has indicated is not expected before 2027. The Q3 2026 earnings call occurred on 2026-11-10, but the actual reported results were not found in the sources checked for this pass — recommend pulling the primary press release/8-K from SEC EDGAR.
